name: The Quiz Master
role: Own product: design and full-stack development
category: Pub-quiz hosting app with an MCP server
facts: Remote MCP server with 17 typed tools at thequizmaster.app/mcp
Own OAuth 2.1 authorization server with dynamic client registration, required S256 PKCE and hashed opaque tokens
Authoring only: no delete tools, and every read or write is scoped to the signed-in host
10 presenter themes, 9 question types, 14 timeline segment types
Media import copies images, audio and video into the app's own storage (25 MB cap, SVG rejected)
About 118 Vue single-file components. Presenter and control panel stay in sync across two windows via BroadcastChannel
Keeps working offline mid-quiz thanks to Firestore's persistent multi-tab cache

mcpTools.name: get_authoring_guide
mcpTools.description: Returns the authoring spec: localized text, segment structure, question and answer shapes, quality guidance. The assistant reads it first.

mcpTools.name: list_themes
mcpTools.description: Lists the presenter themes a quiz can use (Arcade, Cosmos, Quiz Board, Terminus, Chalkboard, ...).

mcpTools.name: list_quizzes
mcpTools.description: Lists the host's quiz templates with languages, theme and per-round question counts.

mcpTools.name: get_quiz
mcpTools.description: Fetches one quiz in full, with the round questions included inline.

mcpTools.name: create_quiz
mcpTools.description: Creates a quiz template; can import a complete running order in one call.

mcpTools.name: update_quiz
mcpTools.description: Patches title, description, theme, languages, settings and metadata.

mcpTools.name: add_segment
mcpTools.description: Inserts a timeline segment (welcome, rules, round, answer reveal, break, scoreboard, ...). A new round gets a matching answer-reveal segment automatically.

mcpTools.name: remove_segment
mcpTools.description: Removes a segment and renumbers the timeline. The questions stay in the question bank.

mcpTools.name: move_segment
mcpTools.description: Moves a segment to a new position in the running order.

mcpTools.name: search_questions
mcpTools.description: Searches the host's question bank by text, tags, type and difficulty.

mcpTools.name: get_question
mcpTools.description: Fetches one question in full (prompt, answer, media, clue stages, sub-questions, tags).

mcpTools.name: create_question
mcpTools.description: Creates a standalone question in the question bank, with an optional image, audio clip or YouTube video.

mcpTools.name: update_question
mcpTools.description: Edits a question. The change shows up in every quiz that uses it.

mcpTools.name: add_questions_to_round
mcpTools.description: Adds new inline questions or existing questions from the bank to a round.

mcpTools.name: remove_question_from_round
mcpTools.description: Unlinks a question from a round without deleting it.

mcpTools.name: import_media
mcpTools.description: Copies a remote image, audio or video file into Quiz Master storage and returns a permanent URL.

en.tagline: Pub-quiz hosting app that AI assistants can write into
en.summary: Quiz Master is a web app for running pub-quiz nights: build the running order, rehearse it, then present it full-screen while scoring teams from a control panel. Its MCP server lets AI assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT write quizzes directly into the host's library. Ask for "a 3-round pub quiz on 90s football" and the finished quiz appears in Quiz Master, ready to host.
useCases: A pub quiz host asks Claude for a themed night and gets a full quiz with rounds, answer reveals and a scoreboard.
A host builds a picture or music round in chat, and the assistant finds the files and imports them into the app's storage.
A host reuses questions from their own bank across quiz nights, and an edit shows up in every quiz that uses the question.
On the night, the host runs the quiz from a laptop while the room watches the presenter screen in the chosen theme.
highlights: Remote MCP server with 17 typed tools validated with zod, covering quizzes, timeline segments, the question bank and media import.
Sign-in is a full OAuth 2.1 flow with dynamic client registration and PKCE, so connecting needs only the server URL and no API key.
The server has no delete tools, and every request only touches data owned by the signed-in host.
10 animated presenter themes built with GSAP. Presenter and control panel run in two windows and keep working offline.

it.tagline: Quiz da pub condotti in sala e scritti anche dall'AI
it.summary: Quiz Master è una web app per condurre serate quiz: si costruisce la scaletta, la si prova e poi la si proietta a schermo intero, assegnando i punti alle squadre da un pannello di controllo. Il suo server MCP permette ad assistenti AI come Claude o ChatGPT di scrivere i quiz direttamente nella libreria dell'host. Basta chiedere "un quiz da pub in 3 round sul calcio anni '90" e il quiz completo compare in Quiz Master, pronto da condurre.
useCases: Un presentatore di quiz chiede a Claude una serata a tema e riceve un quiz completo con round, soluzioni e classifica.
Un presentatore costruisce in chat un round di immagini o di musica, e l'assistente trova i file e li importa nello storage dell'app.
Un presentatore riusa le domande del proprio archivio in più serate, e ogni modifica compare in tutti i quiz che usano quella domanda.
Durante la serata il presentatore guida il quiz dal portatile, mentre la sala guarda lo schermo con il tema scelto.
highlights: Server MCP remoto con 17 strumenti tipizzati e validati con zod per quiz, segmenti della scaletta, archivio domande e import dei media.
L'accesso è un flusso OAuth 2.1 completo, con registrazione dinamica del client e PKCE: per collegarsi basta l'URL del server, senza chiavi API.
Il server non ha strumenti di cancellazione, e ogni richiesta tocca solo i dati dell'host autenticato.
10 temi animati con GSAP per lo schermo del pubblico. Presenter e pannello di controllo girano in due finestre e funzionano anche offline.

sq.tagline: Aplikacion për kuize pubi, ku shkruan edhe asistenti AI
sq.summary: Quiz Master është një aplikacion web për të drejtuar mbrëmje kuizi: ndërton radhën e programit, e provon dhe pastaj e shfaq në ekran të plotë, ndërsa u jep pikë skuadrave nga një panel kontrolli. Serveri i tij MCP u lejon asistentëve AI si Claude ose ChatGPT të shkruajnë kuize direkt në bibliotekën e organizatorit. Mjafton të kërkosh "një kuiz pubi me 3 raunde për futbollin e viteve '90" dhe kuizi i plotë shfaqet në Quiz Master, gati për t'u drejtuar.
useCases: Një organizator kuizesh i kërkon Claude-it një mbrëmje me temë dhe merr një kuiz të plotë me raunde, përgjigje dhe renditje.
Një organizator ndërton në chat një raund me foto ose muzikë, dhe asistenti gjen skedarët dhe i importon në hapësirën e aplikacionit.
Një organizator ripërdor pyetjet e arkivit të vet në disa mbrëmje, dhe çdo ndryshim shfaqet në të gjitha kuizet që e përdorin pyetjen.
Gjatë mbrëmjes organizatori e drejton kuizin nga laptopi, ndërsa salla ndjek ekranin me temën e zgjedhur.
highlights: Server MCP në distancë me 17 mjete të tipizuara dhe të validuara me zod për kuizet, segmentet, arkivin e pyetjeve dhe importin e medias.
Hyrja bëhet me një rrjedhë të plotë OAuth 2.1, me regjistrim dinamik të klientit dhe PKCE: mjafton URL-ja e serverit, pa çelësa API.
Serveri nuk ka mjete fshirjeje, dhe çdo kërkesë prek vetëm të dhënat e organizatorit të identifikuar.
10 tema të animuara me GSAP për ekranin e publikut. Prezantuesi dhe paneli i kontrollit punojnë në dy dritare, edhe pa internet.
